title: test(runtime): the override/merge binder pin asks each package coordinate, the bare id
body:
Fixes #32363
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：多包产物 override/merge 绑定用例里，按包查询的那半段原先传 `app:com.qa.share.one` 这种 owner 键，引擎永远查不到，断言不可能失败；现在改传引擎真正的包坐标（裸包 id），并对每个坐标正向断言它的回答。
- 为什么改：这条钉子守的是 #32333 加的规则「被组合替换掉的声明在任何地址都不绑定」；钉子不会红，等于没守。
- 风险与回滚：只改一个测试文件，不发布任何东西；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.test.ts` 的 `objectConflict` 用例（按包查询的那几行）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/app-artifact-handlers.test.ts`，预期 13 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`packages/runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.test.ts`, the override/merge case of the `[ADR-0150 D4] bindAppArtifactHandlers on a multi-package artifact` block (added by #32333):

- The per-package loop passed `app:com.qa.share.one` / `app:com.qa.share.two` as `packageId`. The engine's package coordinate is the bare id (`actionHandlerCoordinate` strips the `app:` owner prefix), so both calls always missed and `not.toEqual({ from: replaced })` could not fail.
- It now asks the bare ids and asserts what each answers, measured on `origin/main` first:
  - `com.qa.share.one` (the package whose declaration the composition replaced or merged away): the engine's not-registered miss, asserted with the runtime's own classifier `isActionNotRegisteredError` (the reading the action door uses to answer absence);
  - `com.qa.share.two` (the artifact's owner, pinned as a precondition `bound.owner === 'app:com.qa.share.two'`): the reconciled body, `{ from: runs }`;
  - the original intent stays spelled out: the replaced body is not the answer at either coordinate.
- The unqualified-call half is kept unchanged; it now runs after the per-package half, so a replaced body bound under its package reds at the address rather than at the unqualified 409 it would also cause.
- One import line (`isActionNotRegisteredError` from `./action-execution.js`) at the file top, used only by this case.

Measured before the edit (probe at `7ac04795da`, both conflict modes): `app:com.qa.share.one`, `app:com.qa.share.two` and `com.qa.share.one` all answer `Action 'qa_stamp' on object 'qashare_doc' not found`; `com.qa.share.two` answers `{ from: 'two' }` (override) / `{ from: 'same' }` (merge).

## Tests

- File: 13/13 green at `c22c8d48ce`.
- Ablation (once, by `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, source imported relatively so no `dist/` leg): in `actionBindingGroups`, every non-owner holder's body bound under its own package. Anchor 1 -> 0, blob `6b235609820b` -> `8d8d1a358d1f`. Both cases red at the per-package line:

```text
AssertionError: com.qa.share.one answered {"from":"one"}: expected false to be true
AssertionError: com.qa.share.one answered {"from":"same"}: expected false to be true
 Tests  2 failed | 11 skipped (13)
```

Restore proven by the tool: blob after restore == HEAD blob (`6b235609820b`), `git diff HEAD` empty; `git status --porcelain` empty afterwards.

## Acceptance notes

- Nothing publishes: `@objectstack/runtime` ships `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` only, so `skip-changeset`.
- File surface: the claim names the override/merge case only; the one import line at the file top is outside the case body and is used by it alone.
- The green file run and the ablation ran outside the shared verify lock after more than an hour queued, against the closure built at `7ac04795da`; declared narrowing. The runtime suite and typecheck are queued under the lock; CI's Test Core and TypeScript Type Check carry them regardless.

## Verification

- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.test.ts`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at `49c81c4b39`: 49 commands, 47 exit 0; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, needs a whole-workspace build) and `check:type-check-debt` exit 3 (its own verify-lock queue timeout): both NOT MEASURED locally, CI's Lint and Repo Gates runs them.
